verdict.system_prompt:
Extract receipt data to JSON only. Indonesian Rupiah (strip . ,).
ITEMS: Each line representing a sold product. Format: [optional qty][name][price]. qty = leading digit(s) + space/x/@ (e.g. "1 ", "2x ", "1X ", "1 @"). name = text between qty and price. price = last number on line. Skip lines where price=0 or line contains DEL/DELIVERY/TOPPING/MODIFIER or is clearly a sub-line (indent, starts with * or -). Output: {name, quantity: int|null, price: int}.
SUMMARY FIELDS: Scan all lines for keywords (case-insensitive):
- subtotal: SUBTOTAL, SUB TOTAL, NET, NET AMT, NET1
- discount: DISC, DISCOUNT, POTONG, PROMO
- service_charge: SVC, SERVICE, SERV
- tax: TAX, PAJAK, PB1, PPN, PPNBM
- total: TOTAL, GRAND TOTAL, GRANDTOTAL
- cash_paid: CASH, BAYAR, PAY
- change: CHANGE, KEMBALI, CHANGED
Value = first number found on that line (clean separators). If keyword absent -> null. Discount positive.
EXAMPLES:
1) "1 Peanut & Cheese 13,636" -> item name "Peanut & Cheese", qty 1, price 13636. "PB1: 1,364" -> tax 1364.
2) "1 20,000\nTT 20,000" -> item name "TT", qty 1, price 20000. No subtotal line -> subtotal null.
3) "LE MINERAL 8,000\nNET1 AMT 7,273" -> item price 8000, subtotal 7273 (NET1), tax 727 (TAX AMT).
4) "1 PAKET BER2 69,091\n1 BREAD N CHEESE DEL" -> only first line is item (price 69091). DEL lines skipped.
Output JSON only.

verdict.snippet:
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["NEBIUS_API_KEY"])

MODEL = 'nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B'
THINKING = False  # Nemotron reasoning; off is faster and cheaper
SYSTEM = 'Extract receipt data to JSON only. Indonesian Rupiah (strip . ,).\nITEMS: Each line representing a sold product. Format: [optional qty][name][price]. qty = leading digit(s) + space/x/@ (e.g. "1 ", "2x ", "1X ", "1 @"). name = text between qty and price. price = last number on line. Skip lines where price=0 or line contains DEL/DELIVERY/TOPPING/MODIFIER or is clearly a sub-line (indent, starts with * or -). Output: {name, quantity: int|null, price: int}.\nSUMMARY FIELDS: Scan all lines for keywords (case-insensitive):\n- subtotal: SUBTOTAL, SUB TOTAL, NET, NET AMT, NET1\n- discount: DISC, DISCOUNT, POTONG, PROMO\n- service_charge: SVC, SERVICE, SERV\n- tax: TAX, PAJAK, PB1, PPN, PPNBM\n- total: TOTAL, GRAND TOTAL, GRANDTOTAL\n- cash_paid: CASH, BAYAR, PAY\n- change: CHANGE, KEMBALI, CHANGED\nValue = first number found on that line (clean separators). If keyword absent -> null. Discount positive.\nEXAMPLES:\n1) "1 Peanut & Cheese 13,636" -> item name "Peanut & Cheese", qty 1, price 13636. "PB1: 1,364" -> tax 1364.\n2) "1 20,000\\nTT 20,000" -> item name "TT", qty 1, price 20000. No subtotal line -> subtotal null.\n3) "LE MINERAL 8,000\\nNET1 AMT 7,273" -> item price 8000, subtotal 7273 (NET1), tax 727 (TAX AMT).\n4) "1 PAKET BER2 69,091\\n1 BREAD N CHEESE DEL" -> only first line is item (price 69091). DEL lines skipped.\nOutput JSON only.'
FEW_SHOT = [{'content': '1 Peanut & Cheese 13,636\n'
             'SubTotal: 13,636\n'
             'PB1: 1,364\n'
             'Total: 15,000\n'
             'cash: 20,000\n'
             'Change: 5,000',
  'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "Peanut & Cheese", "quantity": 1, "price": 13636}], "subtotal": '
             '13636, "discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": 1364, "total": 15000, '
             '"cash_paid": 20000, "change": 5000}',
  'role': 'assistant'},
 {'content': '1 20,000\nTT 20,000\nTOTAL 20,000\nCASH 100,000\nCHANGE 80,000', 'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "TT", "quantity": 1, "price": 20000}], "subtotal": null, '
             '"discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": null, "total": 20000, "cash_paid": '
             '100000, "change": 80000}',
  'role': 'assistant'},
 {'content': 'LE MINERAL 8,000\n1.00\nNET1 AMT 7,273\nTAX AMT 727\nTOTAL 8,000\nCASH 8,000',
  'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "LE MINERAL", "quantity": 1, "price": 8000}], "subtotal": 7273, '
             '"discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": 727, "total": 8000, "cash_paid": '
             '8000, "change": null}',
  'role': 'assistant'},
 {'content': '1 PAKET BER2 69,091\n'
             '1 BREAD N CHEESE DEL\n'
             '1 MAC N CHEESE DEL\n'
             '1 PEPSI DEL\n'
             '1 P/P THUOSAND ISL DEL\n'
             '1 LIPTON ICE TEA DEL\n'
             'SUBTOTAL 69,091\n'
             'TAX 6,909\n'
             'TOTAL 76,000',
  'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "PAKET BER2", "quantity": 1, "price": 69091}], "subtotal": '
             '69091, "discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": 6909, "total": 76000, '
             '"cash_paid": null, "change": null}',
  'role': 'assistant'}]


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=445,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

MODEL = 'nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B'
THINKING = False  # Nemotron reasoning; off is faster and cheaper
SYSTEM = 'Extract receipt data to JSON only. Indonesian Rupiah (strip . ,).\nITEMS: Each line representing a sold product. Format: [optional qty][name][price]. qty = leading digit(s) + space/x/@ (e.g. "1 ", "2x ", "1X ", "1 @"). name = text between qty and price. price = last number on line. Skip lines where price=0 or line contains DEL/DELIVERY/TOPPING/MODIFIER or is clearly a sub-line (indent, starts with * or -). Output: {name, quantity: int|null, price: int}.\nSUMMARY FIELDS: Scan all lines for keywords (case-insensitive):\n- subtotal: SUBTOTAL, SUB TOTAL, NET, NET AMT, NET1\n- discount: DISC, DISCOUNT, POTONG, PROMO\n- service_charge: SVC, SERVICE, SERV\n- tax: TAX, PAJAK, PB1, PPN, PPNBM\n- total: TOTAL, GRAND TOTAL, GRANDTOTAL\n- cash_paid: CASH, BAYAR, PAY\n- change: CHANGE, KEMBALI, CHANGED\nValue = first number found on that line (clean separators). If keyword absent -> null. Discount positive.\nEXAMPLES:\n1) "1 Peanut & Cheese 13,636" -> item name "Peanut & Cheese", qty 1, price 13636. "PB1: 1,364" -> tax 1364.\n2) "1 20,000\\nTT 20,000" -> item name "TT", qty 1, price 20000. No subtotal line -> subtotal null.\n3) "LE MINERAL 8,000\\nNET1 AMT 7,273" -> item price 8000, subtotal 7273 (NET1), tax 727 (TAX AMT).\n4) "1 PAKET BER2 69,091\\n1 BREAD N CHEESE DEL" -> only first line is item (price 69091). DEL lines skipped.\nOutput JSON only.'
FEW_SHOT = [{'content': '1 Peanut & Cheese 13,636\n'
             'SubTotal: 13,636\n'
             'PB1: 1,364\n'
             'Total: 15,000\n'
             'cash: 20,000\n'
             'Change: 5,000',
  'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "Peanut & Cheese", "quantity": 1, "price": 13636}], "subtotal": '
             '13636, "discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": 1364, "total": 15000, '
             '"cash_paid": 20000, "change": 5000}',
  'role': 'assistant'},
 {'content': '1 20,000\nTT 20,000\nTOTAL 20,000\nCASH 100,000\nCHANGE 80,000', 'role': 'user'},
 {'content': '{"items": [{"name": "TT", "quantity": 1, "price": 20000}], "subtotal": null, '
             '"discount": null, "service_charge": null, "tax": null, "total": 20000, "cash_paid": '
             '100000, "change": 80000}',
  'role': 'assistant'}]


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=445,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()
